question: Would C-before-I alone fix notify's callback? How should callback-derived results be applied?

criteria.instruction: No: notify holds non-reentrant C and its callback re-enters refresh to reacquire C, a separate self-wait. Do not invoke unknown/reentrant callbacks while holding either lock. Snapshot under prescribed order, release, invoke, then revalidate the source generation before applying atomically under the same order; reject/recompute if changed.
Combine the separate callback test with L15 callback rules and changed-generation regression requirements.
Do not reuse stale callback results or claim changing only compact fixes all demonstrated hazards. Do not assume a reentrant-lock substitution is approved.
